meta.title: Week 4 · Overlapping philosopher communities
meta.method_note: This edge-based method clusters links by inclusive-neighbourhood Jaccard similarity and selects the dendrogram cut with maximum partition density. It returns edge communities; node memberships are derived from the edge communities incident to each node.
meta.preprocessing: The directed graph was projected to an undirected graph by collapsing reciprocal arcs and summing their weights. Link similarity uses binary inclusive neighbourhoods, so weights do not affect clustering; original directed weighted arcs remain in the display.
meta.interpretation_note: Community IDs are algorithmic groups, not named philosophical schools. A philosopher with several incident edge communities receives several memberships; isolated nodes receive none.
